title: Christmas Eve with Mishka
scene: Christmas Eve at night. Mishka sits on a cushioned window seat in a warm wooden attic room, seen in profile, looking out a large arched window at a snowy village with glowing lanterns, lit windows and a small clock tower under a deep blue sky with a full moon; snow falling. Inside: a small decorated Christmas tree with warm lights on the left, a candle in a glass jar and a steaming mug on the windowsill, an amber table lamp, a knitted blanket, paper stars hanging from the ceiling beams. Quiet, intimate, nostalgic.
